question_text: Read the following text and fill in each gap with a suitable word based on the information of the text: 15=5
stimulus: Your son stole my date juice! Emptied the juice pots hanging on the date trees! Sonabhan would sigh again. Then ask the visitor to pardon him. She hated saying that she'd raised her son alone. If she could spare them, she would bring half a dozen eggs and hand them to the visitor: Please take these for your children. At night, Sonabhan climbs out of her bed, clutches the hurricane lamp and tiptoes into Ameen's room. She stands by his bed, looks at her sleeping son. He snores like his father. He has her light skin and button nose. She touches his cheek. His broad forehead. She suppresses a desire to lie beside him. Like the old days, when she slept cuddling her baby. Question Sonabhan would often offer the visitor ____________ to make up for her son's mischief. At night, Sonabhan carried a ____________ lamp as she entered Ameen’s room. Ameen resembled his mother in his ____________ and nose. Though angry, Sonabhan always asked the visitor to ____________ her son. Watching her sleeping son, Sonabhan had to fight the urge to ____________ next to him as she did when he was a baby. Read the following text carefully and answer the questions no. 4 and 5 : Marie Curie was born in Poland in 1867. She was a very talented woman who knew several languages. He studied physics and mathematics. She married in 1895. She got Nobel Prize for physics. She became a professor of physics in 1904. She received Nobel Prize for the second time in 1911. She got it for chemistry. She was a very reputed scientist. She died on 4 July in 1934. Ernest Rutherford was a very famous scientist. He was born in New Zealand in 1871. He was a very good student in childhood. He received BA in 1893. He was very good at mathematics and Physics. He invented director of identifying radio wave. He became a professor at Maegil University at 27 only. He got Nobel Prize in 1911. He died in 1937.
